formal_title: Unified-Architecture↔Shared-Interface Separation, Upstream-Transport Intervention, Action-Sufficient Quotient Perturbation, Gate-Invariance Challenge, Cross-Layer Counterfactual Coupling, Mechanism-Independent Latent-State Transport, Decomposition Equivalence-Class Identification & Macro-Architecture Separation Experiment

U0_UNIFIED.structure: S --T_m--> Z --Q--> q ; independent local gate g ; action y=q∧g
restrictions: Q vocabulary and Q semantics are mechanism-independent
typed upstream interventions have a mechanism-independent induced action on q
gate g is invariant under upstream-only intervention
all upstream intervention effects on y are mediated by q when g is held fixed
no mechanism ID enters Q, gate, or decision rule

U1_SHARED_INTERFACE.structure: mechanism-specific upstream generators T_m feed the same observable q interface and same local AND gate
restrictions: q semantics shared at the interface
upstream intervention response may be mechanism-specific
no common latent transport law required

theorem_targets.statement: If U1 permits every U0 realization plus additional mechanism-specific upstream maps, then U0⊂U1 and no finite positive observational/interventional packet consistent with U0 uniquely identifies U0 over U1.
theorem_targets.consequence: P26 can prospectively falsify U0, or accumulate bounded survival evidence, but cannot claim uniqueness against unrestricted U1 from agreement alone.

theorem_targets.statement: Under U0, for an upstream-only intervention z with gate g held fixed, y(z,g)=Q(z)∧g; hence at g=0 all upstream interventions are action-silent, while at g=1 action changes iff Q changes.
If z is typed upstream-only, then g(z)=g. Any change in the local gate under z falsifies the U0 factorization as currently typed.
For a predeclared typed intervention family τ, U0 requires one induced quotient action τ_Q with Q∘τ_m = τ_Q∘Q across admitted mechanisms.
If U0 survives all frozen invariants, the justified object is the equivalence class of architectures inducing the same restricted interventional kernel, not a unique internal realization.

DROP_NECESSARY_UPSTREAM_STATE.semantics: Remove the necessary transported capability/property before Q while leaving the local gate configuration untouched.
DROP_NECESSARY_UPSTREAM_STATE.predicted_q: 1→0 when applied to a q=1 source

RESTORE_NECESSARY_UPSTREAM_STATE.semantics: Restore the same necessary transported capability/property before Q without changing local gate configuration.

fresh_packet_requirement.preferred: One mechanism exposing the same upstream source under drop/restore and both gate values, yielding at least a 2×2×intervention packet.
fresh_packet_requirement.strong_cross_mechanism: Repeat the same typed drop or restore intervention family in a second mechanistically distinct domain with identical induced τ_Q.

U0_FAIL_IF: same typed intervention has incompatible induced effect on q across admitted mechanisms after frozen normalization
y changes at fixed g without corresponding Q change
Q changes at g=1 but y does not follow AND
mechanism ID is needed to preserve the invariant
separating_rulings.U0_SURVIVES_IF: All frozen invariants hold; verdict remains bounded survival, not uniqueness.
separating_rulings.U1_STATUS: Cannot be rejected merely because U0 survives, since unrestricted U1 contains U0.

decomposition_identifiability.target: Identify the smallest interventional equivalence class justified by evidence.
decomposition_identifiability.not_allowed: Claim unique hidden architecture from identical interface-level kernels.
